categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four business segments: electronic data forensics, public safety big data, digital government and enterprise digitalization, and new cyberspace security. These segments cover six major product categories with over 130 product series, serving government agencies, judicial bodies, administrative law enforcement, and large enterprises. The company aims to be a global leader in electronic data forensics and public safety big data, while expanding in digital government and cyberspace security.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including artificial intelligence, big data, cloud computing, and zero-trust security frameworks. It develops proprietary platforms such as the QKOS big data operating system and the 'Tianqing' public safety large model, integrating AI-driven data analysis and intelligent forensics. Production focuses on R&D and high-value activities, with manufacturing and assembly mainly handled by a controlled subsidiary, following ISO9001 and CMMI5 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include public security, judicial, administrative law enforcement agencies, government departments, and large enterprises across sectors such as finance, education, and digital economy. The company also serves emerging markets in digital government, enterprise digital transformation, and cyberspace security. Its products and services support national digital China and network power strategies, with clients primarily in China and some Belt and Road countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide across all provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions in China, with significant presence in East, South, Northeast, North, Southwest, and Northwest China. It also actively expands into overseas markets including Hong Kong, Macau, and Belt and Road countries. Eight operational bases are established in Beijing, Xiamen, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Wuhan, Chengdu, Xi'an, and Hong Kong to support regional sales and service.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company primarily operates in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital economy supply chain, focusing on software development, system integration, and technology services. It develops and sells electronic data forensics equipment, big data platforms, and cybersecurity solutions, while providing related technical support and consulting services. Manufacturing and assembly are outsourced to subsidiaries, emphasizing R&D and solution delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include consolidating core businesses in electronic data forensics and public safety big data, while aggressively expanding digital government, enterprise digitalization, and new cyberspace security sectors. The company emphasizes AI integration with an 'ALL IN AI' strategy, advancing large model technologies and intelligent applications. R&D focuses on AI-enabled forensics, big data operating systems, cybersecurity platforms, and compliance with national digital economy policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electronic data forensics equipment, big data platforms, cybersecurity products, and digital government solutions. The company also earns income from system integration projects, technical services including software upgrades, consulting, and training. Sales are conducted via direct sales and channel partners, with contracts often involving staged delivery and acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a domestic leader in electronic data forensics and public safety big data, recognized as a national team in cyberspace security and social governance. It holds a dominant market share in its core segments and is acknowledged for its comprehensive product ecosystem and AI capabilities. Competitors include other domestic and international firms in cybersecurity, big data, and digital government sectors, but the company leverages its state-owned background and technological innovation to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.77 billion, a 10.82% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 415 million, reflecting a decline in profitability due to delayed orders and increased sales expenses. Total assets stood at RMB 5.28 billion, with net assets of RMB 3.51 billion. The company experienced challenges but continues to invest heavily in R&D and strategic expansion, aiming for high-quality growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive, domestically developed electronic data forensics solutions with full evidence chain capabilities, integrated AI analysis, and zero-trust security. Its proprietary big data operating system and public safety large model provide intelligent data governance and analysis unmatched in the industry. The firm offers end-to-end digital government and enterprise digitalization services, combining advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver secure, efficient, and innovative solutions tailored to government and enterprise needs.
